.. exception:: MultilineContinuationError

   Exception raised when a valueless option is followed by an indented
   continuation line.  Subclass of :exc:`ParsingError`.

   The constructor stores the parsing source in ``source``, the one-based
   line number in ``lineno`` and the exact offending line in ``line``; its
   ``args`` are ``(source, lineno, line)``.  As with :exc:`ParsingError`,
   the offending entry is also recorded in ``errors``.
